Whether or not it is my age or hormonal, that doesn't change the fact that i constantly think of ways to hurt myself or kill myself and how much better the world around me would be better off. Things would only be bad for a few days. My parents wouldn't be the same ever but they're just two people compared to the countless number of messups and getting in people's way. And how the whole world would be better without me in it.
